pages.text: Technetium-99m loses half of itself every six hours - on the scaled clock, every 15 seconds. Carried loose, or dropped on the ground, a vial is spent within a minute.$(br2)Anywhere it is stored it waits instead: in a machine, an ME network, a chest or a $(item)Chronostatic Vault$().

To move it around, carry it in a $(item)Lead Pig$(): right-click the pig with vials on the cursor to put them in (up to 64), and right-click it with an empty hand to take them out. Vials put in at different times share one age, the average of theirs.
